mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_refund (id, refund_no, order_id, order_no, channel, channel_trade_no, amount, status, reason, operator_member_id, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{refundNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{channel}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{operatorMemberId}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment_refund WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM payment_refund WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_refund SET status = #{status}, channel_refund_no = #{channelRefundNo}, refunded_at = #{refundedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE payment_refund SET status = #{newStatus}, channel_refund_no = COALESCE(#{channelRefundNo}, channel_refund_no), refunded_at = COALESCE(#{refundedAt}, refunded_at) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{expectStatus}
